declaration.title: Selected object labels and annotations have no detected secrets
declaration.remediation: Remove credential literals from object metadata and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use an appropriate secret reference instead.
declaration.scope: Top-level labels and annotations of exact selected supported objects only; no template metadata, references, files, Secrets, logs, images or execution.

summary: Independently reviewed the labels/annotations-only SDK reader and private literal-function clones, fixed two reproduced draft-only defects, and sealed source/native-case inputs without registering or changing shared collectors, planning, validation, catalogs, original literals or historical fixtures.

native_scope.read: Exactly two named native GETs must agree before scanning; core/v1, apps/v1 and batch/v1 built-in objects only. Existing authenticated SDK client and bounded origin-constrained pool are reused. Full native responses are transient; only top-level metadata and identity strings are inspected.
native_scope.selector: content_secret_scans true plus private exact metadata kind authorization; 1-8 unique {cluster_id,namespace,kind,name} in requested scopes and one exact configured cluster. Wildcard selectors and extra fields rejected; wildcard requested scan scope still permits only the explicit named GETs.
native_scope.identity: Exact native GVK and requested namespace/name, nonempty opaque UID/resourceVersion, no deletion or partial/list markers; stable extracted metadata and UID/RV across both reads. Identity and source references are HMAC/opaque in output.
native_scope.source_provenance: Actual authenticated SDK fake HTTP goes through existing _BoundedPool, reader.call and strict bounded stream parsing. Source receipts record GET200, exact-selected route, byte counts, ordinal and identity binding; no caller completeness attestations or copied CASES are used as provider inputs. This is proposed collector -> public evaluate_snapshot with a test-local Check, not engine.collect_snapshot or registered production collection.

fixes.witness: wire-debug-native-before:4 red; configured SDK pool debug and HTTPS/urllib3 debug cases demonstrated native reads continued. New producer-only _read checks existing _wire_debug_enabled before each read, keeping private SDK log filtering.
fixes.limits: A first test set stdlib debug before Configuration construction, which legitimately reset it; corrected fixture sets actual debug state after SDK construction. The expanded-run red for that setup issue is retained.

fixes.witness: resource-cap-before: genuine hit became UNKNOWN with two targets and max_resources=1, despite two complete reads and detector hit on the first object.
fixes.fix: New consumer-only _bounded_partial_hit accepts FAIL only after the unchanged inherited evaluator revalidates the observed native item, receipts, detector state and exact selected subset under the actual resource_limit partial envelope. It uses a temporary membership projection; retained index/markers/receipts and original full selection are unchanged. It cannot produce PASS.

privacy.verification: Never attempted; existing offline Kingfisher policy and TruffleHog no-verification/no-update/no-verification-cache path retained. Actual detector cases ran under OS network denial.
privacy.persistence: No native body, raw metadata maps, raw matches, auth headers, native identity or exception text added to snapshots/caches. Shared exact-value HMAC, union scrub across keys/scopes/locations/plaintext and common encodings, transient match-set clearing and clean-only redacted cache behavior verified. No forensic RAM-zeroization claim.
privacy.independent_hit: Either independently completed detector hit remains FAIL with explicit incomplete coverage when its peer is unavailable; unscanned or incomplete absence is UNKNOWN.
privacy.original_namespace: Private clones and metadata authorization remain isolated from the installed literal namespace; original literal source/functions and default routes unchanged.

bounds.caller_budget: Existing K8sReader call/resource/deadline/cancellation budgets apply in addition; no new worker, private auth, independent native budget or retry/redirect path.

prepared_admission.api: reviewed_inputs(root=None) -> (fresh receipt, native CASES, fresh declaration, evaluator). No install() and no registry hook.
prepared_admission.guards: Exact new source and fixture hashes; narrow named shared callable source/code, private-clone code/global identity, source/consumer/imported helper binding, regex/schema/version and actual native verdict replay. No shared module whole-file freeze or new general introspection framework.

native_fixtures.provider_inputs: Independent actual-shaped native objects built by tests; sanitized derived snapshots/indexes only are sealed as CASES.
native_fixtures.old_captures: Original root pass/fail/unknown captures and all old logs/XML retained byte-for-byte in predecessor archive.

test_environment.in_process_guards: Socket connect/connect_ex/sendto, DNS create_connection/getaddrinfo/gethostbyname/gethostbyname_ex and external kubeconfig/incluster credential loading blocked. Fake native transport asserts GET, exact HTTPS origin/path, no query/body, bearer header and retries/redirect/preload/decode disabled.

sources.reviewed: Label keys/values are bounded strings with documented optional DNS prefix; empty label values valid.
Annotation keys follow the documented key form; values may be arbitrary strings. Newlines are inspected as literal content, never executed.
Exact resource GET, native GVK and opaque resourceVersion/UID semantics; no list or effective runtime claim.
Namespace Role get with exact resourceNames is sufficient; no Secret, log, exec, list/watch or grant permission needed.

remaining_limits: Unregistered: no production planner, collector job, public-option validator, final cross-adapter scrub hook, canonical metadata, registry or UI activation in this task. Coordinator must admit those atomically later.

Only ten supported namespaced built-in kinds and top-level labels/annotations; no Namespace/custom-resource/cluster-scoped object, nested template metadata, ConfigMap data, Pod specs, Secret contents, external references, logs, files, images or execution.

Two bounded GETs establish observed declaration consistency, not later immutability, resource ownership beyond authenticated API identity, detector completeness for all secret formats, credential validity or effective access.

No entries, missing facts, malformed/unsupported fields, partial/denied responses, changed identity, oversized objects or unavailable detectors cannot prove absence; sufficiently large valid native metadata is conservatively UNKNOWN.
A resource-cap fallback preserves already validated hits only. Other expired read/scan budgets may remain UNKNOWN, with discovered transient values still scrubbed; no timed-out clean inference.

Existing SDK authentication/TLS transport is reused; this proposal adds no new authentication or authorization source. Future hosted integration must retain existing credential/cluster selection and privacy guards.
next_owner: Root owns admission/registration, production planner/collector/server wiring, canonical groups/prose/CSV/UI/materializer. Source is settled for that later finite integration.
